title: 第二十一章 收服巨大快龙与治疗第二十二章 十六岁的成人礼和推到花子
content_zh:
克制龙的冰在巨大快龙身上并不显著，效果不佳。
林萧立刻放弃了让快龙利用冰属性压制得想法，对三只小精灵喊道：“炎帝使用大字爆，快龙用打雷！班吉拉最大威力的亿万冲击波，攻击它的脚！！！”
由于亿万冲击波需要凝聚的时间，炎帝和快龙优先攻击，给班吉拉打掩护。
“班！！！”
班吉拉怒吼一声，身上围起一道紫光，为亿万冲击波凝聚能量。游戏中的亿万冲击波是瞬间发动的，现实里也可以这样，但凝聚能量的时间越久爆发的威力越大，班吉拉选择了凝聚能量。
“嗷！！！”随着班吉拉身上的紫光开始增强，巨大快龙急怒着，使出龙之怒朝快龙袭去。
快龙没有想到巨大快龙硬抗打雷和大字爆的伤害对自己使用龙之怒，想要闪避已为时已晚，比快龙还大的火球直接将它包裹冲向地面。“轰！”一声巨响，沙滩上被撞出个深坑，被龙之怒正面命中的快龙，浑身冒着黑烟，晕死过去。
“该死！”林萧也没有想到巨大快龙会以伤换伤，把快龙收回。
“炎帝，火焰车冲上去，使用燃烧殆尽！！！”
“吼！！！”
炎帝使用火焰车怒吼着撞向巨大快龙。
巨大快龙嘴里喷出银白色的暴风雪想要阻止炎帝，奔跑中的炎帝持有的火山爆发特性加上火焰车的提速，轻快的避开暴风雪，撞在巨大快龙身上。这种特性是是炎帝专属的，属于神兽的自然本源，炎帝虽然是最弱小的神兽，但毕竟挂了一个神字，火山爆发特性可以为炎帝短幅度提升速度和火焰温度。
“碰！”巨大快龙被炎帝撞到的地方，龙鳞破碎，焦黑一片，一股糊臭味缓缓升起。
撞上巨大快龙后，炎帝怒吼一声，身上的幽蓝火焰开始疯狂的猛涨，就连嘴里和眼睛都冒着火焰，刹那间巨大快龙的周围百米以内都被幽蓝色的火焰包围，做完这一切的炎帝，喘着粗气，晕死过去。
“吼！！！！！”
巨大快龙挣扎着飞上天空，炎帝的燃烧殆尽对它伤害很大，身上到处是被火焰烧焦，烧黑的地方。
“班！！”
已经凝聚好亿万冲击波能量的班吉拉怎么可能眼睁睁的看着巨大快龙脱离火海，带着一股紫色光线，班吉拉一往无前的冲向巨大快龙。
刚飞起的巨大快龙被班吉拉的亿万冲击波命中，巨大的身体就像陨石一样重重的砸在了沙滩上，柔软的沙滩上出现一个巨大的坑洞。
“呜~~~~~”被亿万冲击波击中的巨大快龙伤上加伤，拖着一身伤痕在深坑中挣扎着想要站起来，但被班吉拉撞击的左腿软软的吊着，不用想，快龙的这条腿断了，巨大的疼痛让巨大快龙头上布满冷汗，浑身颤抖。

“班！！”
班吉拉喘着粗气对巨大快龙发出咆哮，身上泛起淡淡的光芒，困扰它多日的瓶颈终于被打破。
“正辉博士，麻烦你帮我准备直升机，我要马上护送小精灵道枯叶市治疗。小智、小刚、小霞还有芽衣，你们帮忙救火，别引起森林火灾。”林萧头也不回的朝沙滩上跑去。
“直升机，在你战斗的时候我就准备好了。”正辉朝林萧喊道，同时丢给林萧一个精灵球，“用这个大师球收服它吧，普通的超重球承载不了它的力量。”
林萧对正辉道谢后奔出正辉灯塔来到沙滩上，收起班吉拉和昏迷中的炎帝对对巨大快龙说道：“你已经败了，别挣扎了。你的伤很重，需要马上治疗，救治不及时会让你的身体存在各种暗伤，实力也会下降。”
听了林萧的话，巨大快龙轻鸣两声，安静的趴在坑洞里不再乱动，灵动的双眼一动不动的望着林萧。
“去吧，大师球。”林萧扔出大师球将巨大快龙收服，随后上了正辉准备好的直升机朝枯叶市而去。
content_en:
The ice that restrains the dragon is not obvious on the giant dragon, and the effect is not good.
Lin Xiao immediately gave up the idea of letting Kuailong use the ice attribute to suppress it, and shouted to the three elves: "Emperor Yan uses Big Explosion, Kuailong uses Thunder! Bangila's most powerful billions of shock waves, attack its feet!!!"
Since the billions of shock waves needed time to condense, Emperor Yan and Kuailong attacked first and provided cover for Bangila.
"Ban!!!"
Bangila roared angrily, and a purple light surrounded his body, condensing energy for billions of shock waves. The billions of shock waves in the game are activated instantly, and they can be like this in reality, but the longer the energy is condensed, the more powerful the explosion will be. Bangila chose to condense the energy.
"Ouch!!!" As the purple light on Bangila began to intensify, the huge dragon became furious and attacked the dragon with dragon's wrath.
Kuailong didn't expect that the huge Kuailong could withstand the damage of thunder and large-scale explosions and use Dragon's Fury on himself. It was too late to dodge, and the fireball bigger than Kuailong directly enveloped it and rushed to the ground. "Boom!" There was a loud noise, and a deep pit was knocked out on the beach. Kuailong, who was hit head-on by Dragon's Wrath, fainted with black smoke all over his body.
"Damn it!" Lin Xiao didn't expect that the huge dragon would exchange injuries for injuries and take the dragon back.
"Emperor Yan, rush forward with the flame chariot and use it to burn it all!!!"
"Roar!!!"
Emperor Yan used his flame car to roar into the giant dragon.
The giant dragon spewed out a silvery white blizzard from its mouth in an attempt to stop Emperor Yan. The running Yandi possessed the volcanic eruption properties and the speed of the flame car, briskly avoiding the blizzard and crashing into the giant dragon. This characteristic is exclusive to Yan Emperor and belongs to the natural origin of the mythical beast. Although Yan Emperor is the weakest mythical beast, it has a divine character after all. The volcanic eruption characteristic can briefly increase the speed and flame temperature of Yan Emperor.
"Bump!" Where the huge dragon was hit by Emperor Yan, the dragon's scales were shattered and burnt black, and a stinky smell slowly rose.
After hitting the giant dragon, Emperor Yan roared angrily, and the blue flames on his body began to surge wildly. Even his mouth and eyes were bursting with flames. In an instant, the giant dragon was surrounded by blue flames within a hundred meters. After doing all this, Emperor Yan gasped and fainted.
"Roar!!!!"
The huge dragon struggled to fly into the sky. The burning out of Yan Emperor hurt it greatly, and its body was scorched and blackened by the flames.
"Ban!!"
How could Bangira, who had already condensed billions of shock wave energy, watch helplessly as the giant dragon escaped from the sea of fire? With a burst of purple light, Bangira rushed towards the giant dragon without any further ado.
The huge dragon that had just taken off was hit by Banjira's billions of shock waves. Its huge body hit the beach like a meteorite, and a huge pothole appeared on the soft beach.
"Woo~~~~~" The huge Kuailong was hit by billions of shock waves and was more injured. He struggled to stand up in the deep pit with scars all over his body, but the left leg hit by Bangira was hanging softly. Needless to say, Kuailong's leg was broken. The huge pain made the huge Kuailong's head covered with cold sweat and his whole body trembled.
"Ban!!"
Bangila gasped and roared at the giant dragon, a faint light glowed on his body, and the bottleneck that had troubled it for many days was finally broken.
"Dr. Zhenghui, please help me prepare a helicopter. I will immediately escort the elf to Dry Leaf City for treatment. Xiaozhi, Xiaogang, Xiaoxia and Meiyi, please help put out the fire and don't cause a forest fire." Lin Xiao ran towards the beach without looking back.
"Helicopter, I will be ready when you fight." Zhenghui shouted to Lin Xiao, and at the same time threw Lin Xiao a Poké Ball, "Use this Master Ball to conquer it, ordinary super heavy balls cannot bear its power."
Lin Xiao thanked Zhenghui and ran out of the Zhenghui Lighthouse to the beach. He put away Bangila and faced off against the unconscious Emperor Yan.Kuailong said: "You have been defeated, stop struggling. Your injury is very serious and needs immediate treatment. Failure to receive timely treatment will cause various hidden injuries to your body and your strength will also decrease."
After listening to Lin Xiao's words, the huge dragon roared twice, lay quietly in the hole and stopped moving, looking at Lin Xiao motionlessly with its smart eyes.
"Go, Master Ball." Lin Xiao threw the Master Ball to subdue the giant dragon, then boarded the helicopter prepared by Zhenghui and headed towards Dead Leaf City.
